topic: A person discovers their child has the same teacher they had
text: Finding out that my child has the same teacher I once had feels like a gentle loop of life, connecting past and present. I recall the days in Ms. Harper's classroom, the way she made history come alive, and her knack for making each student feel seen. Walking down the hallway to check in on the first day, I see her through the glass window, the smile that guides her words, unchanged by time. It’s a reassuring sight, knowing that my child will experience the same warmth and wisdom that shaped me. After class, introducing myself as a former student, we share a laugh over the coincidence, and I leave with a sense of continuity, the past threading seamlessly into the future.
